多路传输
连接切换
网络质量评估
弱网感知
如何监听多网状态变化，感知可用网络的变更？
如何监听系统的多网加速建议并决策发起多网请求？
如何查询多网并发的配额信息（已使用和剩余的次数和时长）？
如何发起和释放多网并发请求？
如何设置业务场景帮助系统进行多网并发管控？
如何订阅连接迁移开始和完成的通知？
如何设置委托模式或自主模式的连接迁移？
如何订阅网络质量评估（QoS）信息？
如何识别当前网络场景（如高铁、电梯等特殊环境）？
如何实现弱网感知判决，检测弱网状态？
当您的应用需要在弱网环境下保障网络通信质量时，应使用Network Boost Kit
典型场景包括：实时视频通话应用需要通过多网并发避免网络卡顿、直播应用需要在WiFi和蜂窝之间无缝切换、游戏应用需要实时感知网络质量以调整策略、下载类应用需要利用多网加速提升下载速度等
当您需要获取网络质量评估信息、检测弱网状态、识别当前网络场景（如高铁、电梯等特殊环境），或者需要向系统反馈应用的传输体验以优化网络调度策略时，也应使用Network Boost Kit的网络质量感知能力
实现 Wi‑Fi 和蜂窝同时传输来提升下载速度 / Enable concurrent Wi‑Fi and cellular transfer to speed up downloads
在弱网场景下自动切换到更优链路保持请求不中断 / Automatically switch to a better link in poor network conditions without interrupting requests
接入多网并发能力给视频播放和直播做抗卡顿优化 / Integrate multi-network concurrency to reduce stalling for video playback and live streaming
根据网络质量评分动态调整上传下载策略 / Dynamically adjust upload and download strategy based on network quality scores
监听网络迁移事件并在切网时平滑续传任务 / Listen for connection migration events and smoothly resume transfers during network switching
获取当前多网加速额度并控制高优先级任务的使用 / Get current multi-network acceleration quota and control usage for high-priority tasks
为文件上传实现断网无感切换和链路迁移 / Implement seamless failover and link migration for file uploads
识别高铁电梯等特殊网络场景并优化请求策略 / Detect special network environments like high-speed rail or elevators and optimize request strategy
订阅可用网络变化并在主备链路间自动切换 / Subscribe to available network changes and automatically switch between primary and backup links
给下载器增加多路径传输能力提升成功率和时延表现 / Add multipath transfer to a downloader to improve success rate and latency
为实时通话或互动业务选择自主连接迁移模式 / Use autonomous connection migration mode for real-time calling or interactive services
设置业务场景标签让系统智能决策是否启用网络加速 / Set business scenario hints so the system can decide when to enable network acceleration
do_not_use_when: 需求是做蓝牙、BLE、Wi‑Fi STA/P2P/AP 或 NFC 标签读写与卡模拟等短距无线交互；应改用 connectivity-kit / The task is about short-range wireless features such as Bluetooth, BLE, Wi‑Fi STA/P2P/AP, or NFC tag reading/writing and card emulation; use connectivity-kit instead

需求是同账号设备间共享相机、扫描或图库能力，在手机、平板和PC之间实现协同使用；应改用 service-collaboration-kit / The task is to share camera, scanning, or gallery capabilities across same-account phones, tablets, and PCs for collaborative use; use service-collaboration-kit instead
preconditions: 应用运行在Phone、Tablet或PC/2in1设备，且目标网络类型为Wi‑Fi或Cellular / The app runs on a Phone, Tablet, or PC/2in1 device, and the target network types are Wi-Fi or Cellular
工程已集成Network Boost Kit对应SDK/API，所选ArkTS或C/C++接口在当前工程中可用 / The project has integrated the Network Boost Kit SDK/API, and the chosen ArkTS or C/C++ interfaces are available in the current project

如使用多网并发/连接迁移能力，已完成所需受限权限、ACL申请及module.json5中的权限声明 / If using multi-network concurrency or connection migration, the required restricted permission, ACL approval, and permission declarations in module.json5 have been completed
设备当前至少存在可用网络环境，且相关网络功能已开启并可被系统管理 / At least one usable network is currently available on the device, and the relevant network functions are enabled and manageable by the system
inputs: 业务场景类型或加速场景标识 / business scenario type or acceleration scenario identifier
多网请求参数或迁移模式配置 / multi-network request parameters or migration mode configuration
QoS订阅项、弱网门限或网络场景监听配置 / QoS subscription items, weak-network thresholds, or network-scene listening configuration
传输体验反馈数据 / transport experience feedback data
outputs: 网络质量感知 - ArkTS接口
网络质量感知 - C/C++接口

postconditions.statement: 代码中已引入并调用Network Boost Kit相关API，而非仅使用普通网络接口 / The code imports and calls Network Boost Kit APIs rather than only ordinary network APIs
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add imports or API calls belonging to Network Boost Kit for acceleration, migration, QoS, weak-network sensing, or feedback?

postconditions.statement: 针对目标能力已建立对应配置或订阅逻辑，如多网监听/请求、迁移通知、QoS监听、场景识别或弱网判决 / The implementation establishes the corresponding configuration or subscription logic for the target capability, such as multi-network monitoring/requesting, migration notifications, QoS listening, scene recognition, or weak-network judgment
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there concrete setup, listener registration, subscription, or request/release logic for a Network Boost capability?

postconditions.statement: 若实现多网并发能力，代码包含资源释放、取消订阅或停止监听等清理处理 / If multi-network concurrency is implemented, the code includes cleanup such as releasing resources, unregistering subscriptions, or stopping listeners
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits add multi-network requests or listeners, do they also include matching release, unsubscribe, or cleanup handling?
